title: Targeting CCR5 with miltefosine as a therapeutic strategy for thrombocytopenia.
authors: Li, Qinyao; Zhang, Ting; Li, Zhichao; Qi, Xiao; Mei, Xinyue; Liu, Sheng; He, Siyu; Qiao, Gan; Li, Rong; Shen, Hongping; Zeng, Jing; Huang, Feihong; Dai, Shuang; Li, Sirui; Luo, Jiesi; Wu, Jianming; Wang, Long
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物米替福新靶向CCR5促进巨核细胞分化治疗血小板减少症，虽涉及分子对接和转录因子，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Thrombocytopenia remains a challenging clinical condition with limited treatment options. Here, we demonstrated that miltefosine stimulated megakaryocyte (MK) differentiation in vitro. Miltefosine significantly accelerated platelet recovery, enhanced platelet function, and boosted MK production and differentiation in irradiated mice. RNA sequencing revealed association of CCR5, MAPK, and JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathways in miltefosine-mediated MK differentiation. Molecular docking, drug affinity responsive target stability (DARTS), and surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assays confirmed direct binding of miltefosine to CCR5. Inhibition of CCR5 disrupted miltefosine's effects on MK differentiation and activation of MAPK and JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathways, as well as key transcription factors GATA1, EGR1, and TAL1. Similarly, blockade of the MAPK or JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathways hindered miltefosine-induced MK differentiation and transcription factor activation. Our findings establish CCR5 as a therapeutic target for thrombocytopenia and identify miltefosine as a CCR5 agonist that promotes MK differentiation and platelet production via MAPK and JAK2/STAT3 signaling.
abstract_zh: 血小板减少症仍然是一种具有挑战性的临床状况，治疗选择有限。在此，我们证明了米替福新（miltefosine）在体外刺激巨核细胞（MK）分化。米替福新显著加速了受照射小鼠的血小板恢复，增强了血小板功能，并促进了MK的产生和分化。RNA测序揭示了CCR5、MAPK和JAK2/STAT3信号通路与米替福新介导的MK分化相关。分子对接、药物亲和力响应靶标稳定性（DARTS）和表面等离子体共振（SPR）实验确认了米替福新与CCR5的直接结合。抑制CCR5破坏了米替福新对MK分化以及MAPK和JAK2/STAT3信号通路激活的作用，同时也影响了关键转录因子GATA1、EGR1和TAL1。同样，阻断MAPK或JAK2/STAT3信号通路阻碍了米替福新诱导的MK分化和转录因子激活。我们的发现将CCR5确立为血小板减少症的治疗靶点，并确定米替福新为一种CCR5激动剂，通过MAPK和JAK2/STAT3信号促进MK分化和血小板生成。
